substeps.caption: A zwickiLine Z5.0 lying on its side: ZwickRoell says it can run horizontal. 1289 mm long, 408 mm tall this way, 78 kg.
The arm lowers the bar between the open jaws from above (it holds the bar by its middle; not drawn).
The pneumatic jaws close on both ends.
The crosshead pulls at constant speed. An E8 sub-size bar faced to 6 x 1.5 mm: 3.7 kN at 412 MPa, within the 5 kN.
Fracture. The crosshead moves on 20 mm to show the break.
The jaws open for the arm. The alloy route's 6 x 6 mm bar needs 14.8 kN: no motorized horizontal machine with a published size pulls that.
